description: PLATEAU's underground building group fixture (Z-common-01_xlink_01) read and written back: grp:CityObjectGroup is written as a top-level object although it has no geometry, ahead of the building as in the source, and its two grp:groupMember entries and its grp:parent are xlink:href links to the rooms and the uro:UndergroundBuilding written in the same document, not copies of them. The rooms stay in the building. The root declares grp only because the document writes a group. New-world only: the legacy writer does not nest objects and does not write groups.
